definitions.explanation: being charged or convicted of a crime one did not commit

examples.japanese: {冤罪|えんざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{投獄|とうごく}→投獄：15733_tougoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was imprisoned on false charges.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、{冤罪|えんざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After years of trials, his innocence was proven.

examples.japanese: {冤罪|えんざい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}した→謝罪する：19520_shazaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The government apologized to the victim of the wrongful conviction case.

notes:
{冤罪|えんざい} refers to being falsely charged or convicted of a crime one did not commit. A serious legal and social issue.

FORMS:
{冤|えん} (false charge, injustice) + {罪|ざい} (crime, guilt)
